label: Outside
title: Nature, first
text: I'm a nature lover, and I like plants. Away from a desk, outside is where I'd rather be.
alt: Avery in an LSU cap and a plaid shirt, grinning while leaning on the bow of a canoe at the edge of a clear river, with green bluffs behind.

label: The levee
title: Bike rides on the levee
text: Some days I ride my bike along the levee by the river. It's the best way I know to clear my head.
alt: A paved path running straight to the horizon between mown grass, under a blue sky full of clouds.

label: Tyga
title: My cat, Tyga
text: Tyga is my cat, and I love that cat.
alt: Tyga, a spotted cat with green eyes, sitting upright and looking straight at the camera.
